sentences.en: We discussed the matter from an educational point of view.
sentences.zh: 我们从教育的角度讨论了这个问题。

sentences.en: People feel educational standards slipped when the government cut finances.
sentences.zh: 人们觉得政府削减预算后教育标准下滑了。

sentences.en: Educational reforms still have a long way to go.
sentences.zh: 教育改革还有很长的路要走。
